blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The opening of the Cavite-Laguna Expressway (Calax) and the Cavite Expressway (Cavitex)-Calax Link (CCLink) is expected to boost economic activity in Cavite and Laguna by improving connectivity and providing motorists with alternatives to heavily congested roads, government officials said during an inspection on Thursday. The officials made the remarks during an inspection of the expressway projects. Public Works Secretary Giovanni “Banoy” Lopez said the improved road network would benefit areas that host numerous economic zones, factories and major businesses. “Cavite and Laguna are home to our economic zones and numerous businesses.
